cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned my bowl upside down like yours. Neat serving method. What keeps the soup in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I dropped mine. I don't know why it's staying there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Drop tested, yes. Turn the spoon over. Let's test which thing owns down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the spoon sets the direction. Point it into the sink before we try putting it down.

reason: Copied accidental bowl inversion becomes claimed method; A covers the correction and derives a practical strange-world rule from B experiment result.
